title: Outlander
author: Diana Gabaldon
summary: A married British combat nurse touches a standing stone in the Scottish Highlands in 1945 and finds herself in the 1740s. She is drawn into the clans' politics and into a marriage to a young Highland warrior.
readIf: you want a long, absorbing historical romance with adventure, danger and a lot of Scottish detail.
skipIf: you want a light read or are uneasy with graphic violence and sexual cruelty in the text.

pairings.reason: A very long, immersive historical novel with violence, ambition and a love story inside it.
Another time-travel romance, but contemporary and more intimate than adventurous.
A much lighter, shorter historical romance for when you want the period charm without the brutality.
